findings.message: Time-ordered rows are split without respecting time; the model trains on rows that are later than rows it is evaluated on.

evidence.detail: column `Date` (parsed as datetime); column `Month` (date-like name); column `Year` (date-like name); rows sorted by time; order-dependent operations: lag, window or fill feature `Close_Lag1`, lag, window or fill feature `Target_Next_Close`
100% of training rows are dated after the earliest evaluation row (`Date`)

suggested_fix.description: Sort by time and split without shuffling (shuffle=False), or use TimeSeriesSplit with the same number of folds.
